subject: general
question: Which State government launched a cryogenic facility to preserve endangered plant species in February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Tamil Nadu government launched a cryogenic facility in February 2025 to preserve endangered plant species.
 
• This initiative aims to ensure the long-term conservation of the state’s rich biodiversity, especially rare and threatened plants.
 
• Cryogenic preservation involves storing seeds, pollen, and plant tissues at ultra-low temperatures (below -150°C) to maintain their viability for decades or even centuries.
 
• The facility is part of Tamil Nadu’s efforts to combat biodiversity loss due to climate change, habitat destruction, and other anthropogenic factors.
 
• It aligns with global conservation strategies under the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) and supports national biodiversity goals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kerala**

 
 
• Kerala is known for its rich biodiversity and conservation efforts through initiatives like the Silent Valley National Park and the Periyar Tiger Reserve.
 
• The state focuses on sustainable development and eco-tourism to protect its natural resources.
 
 
 
• **Karnataka**
 
 
• Karnataka is home to diverse ecosystems, including the Western Ghats, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• The state has several conservation programs, such as protecting its unique flora and fauna in Bandipur and Nagarhole National Parks.
 
 
 
• **Telangana**
 
 
• Telangana has undertaken various green initiatives, such as the Haritha Haram program, to increase forest cover and preserve biodiversity.
 
• While the state has focused on afforestation and biodiversity conservation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Cryogenic Preservation**

 
 
• Cryogenic preservation is a cutting-edge technology used to maintain the genetic material of species for long-term conservation.
 
• It helps protect species that are at risk of extinction due to habitat loss, climate change, or other challenges.
 
• This technology is widely used in seed banks, botanical research, and biodiversity conservation programs worldwide.
